macros.name: ifoptionanyof
macros.doc: Does the option value occur in the comma separated value list ⟨list⟩?

macros.name: ifoptionblank
macros.doc: Is the option value blank (empty or spaces)?

macros.name: ifoptioncontains
macros.doc: Check if a list option contains a certain element.

macros.name: ifoptiondefined
macros.doc: Is the option defined?

macros.name: ifoptionequal
macros.doc: Is the option value equal to the provided value?

macros.name: ifoptioniscode
macros.doc: Is this option just an action? i.e. it has no associated value.

macros.name: ifoptionnil
macros.doc: Is list option value empty?

macros.name: ifoptiontype
macros.doc: Does the option have type ⟨type⟩?

macros.name: ifoptionvoid
macros.doc: Is the option undefined or is its value blank (empty or spaces)?

macros.name: letoptiontype
macros.doc: Bind the type of an option to \⟨type⟩.

macros.name: option
macros.doc: This uses the current value of ⟨option⟩. It directly expands to the command \optk@⟨option⟩ and is very efficient.

macros.name: optionerror
macros.doc: Raise a package error for ⟨option⟩ with a certain message.

macros.name: optionlistdo
macros.doc: Perform ⟨action⟩ on every element of the current value of ⟨list option⟩.

macros.name: optionname
macros.doc: Expand to the internal name of an options, i.e. optk@⟨option⟩.

macros.name: optionprependcode
macros.doc: Add some code to ⟨option⟩/@code right after the argument check.

macros.name: options@ProcessOptions
macros.doc: Call this in a package (.sty) or class (.cls) file to handle the options passed to it.

macros.name: optionsalso
macros.doc: Just like \options except it will use the current default path and option flags.

macros.name: optionshow
macros.doc: Show the value of ⟨option⟩.

macros.name: optionshowall
macros.doc: Show all the options that are defined.

macros.name: optionshowpath
macros.doc: Show all the options defined under a certain path.

macros.name: optionswithremaining
macros.doc: The command takes a list of options that are processed before the options in the remaining list.

macros.name: optionwarning
macros.doc: Output a package warning for ⟨option⟩ with a certain message.
